name: David Goldstein
bio:
David Goldstein is a highly skilled tattoo artist specializing in the vibrant and dynamic 'newschool' style, perfect for those who want to make a bold statement with their ink. Based in the heart of Portland, Oregon, David operates out of Dead Gods Tattoo with an unwavering commitment to cleanliness, ensuring each client's experience is not only visually stunning but also held to the highest standards of hygiene. To see his striking work or book a consultation, visit his portfolio on the Dead Gods Tattoo website.
